Yuna: Daniel has a loud, clear voice, so I believe he {{g:should be the one presenting|should + 동사원형: ~해야 한다 / the one + -ing: ~하는 사람}} in front of the class.
Tom: I completely agree. What will you be {{v:in charge of}}, then?
Yuna: I'll take care of writing the script. Keep in mind that the presentation {{g:has to|has to + 동사원형: ~해야 한다 (= must)}} {{v:last}} exactly five minutes, no more and no less.
Tom: In that case, {{g:we'd better get together|had better('d better) + 동사원형: ~하는 게 좋겠다}} and {{v:rehearse}}. When would be {{v:convenient}} for everyone?
Yuna: How about Monday after school? Let's meet in the library at three thirty.
Tom: Sounds great. I'll pass the plan along to Jimin and Daniel.

questions.q: What is the main purpose of the conversation?
choices: To decide who will do each part of the presentation
To choose a topic for the presentation

To ask the teacher for more time

questions.q: Which information about the presentation is NOT given in the conversation?
questions.explanation: 받을 점수는 나오지 않는다. 날짜(다음 주 수요일), 주제(한국의 동물), 길이(정확히 5분), 인원(4명)은 나온다.

questions.q: Why does Tom volunteer to collect pictures?
choices: He has a loud, clear voice.
He is fairly comfortable with computers.
He wants to write the script.
questions.answer: He is fairly comfortable with computers.
questions.explanation: 'I'm fairly comfortable with computers, so I'll be responsible for collecting pictures'와 일치한다.

questions.q: According to Yuna, why is Jimin the perfect person to design the poster?
choices: She is remarkably talented at drawing.
She has a loud, clear voice.
She knows a lot about animals.
She is good at writing scripts.
questions.answer: She is remarkably talented at drawing.
questions.explanation: 'Jimin is remarkably talented at drawing, so she would be the perfect person to design the poster.'와 일치한다.

questions.q: Which role suits Daniel best, and why?
choices: Presenting, because he has a loud, clear voice
Drawing, because he is talented at art
Writing the script, because he speaks clearly
Collecting pictures, because he likes computers
Designing the poster, because he has a clear voice
questions.answer: Presenting, because he has a loud, clear voice
questions.explanation: 'Daniel has a loud, clear voice, so I believe he should be the one presenting'과 일치한다.

questions.q: What will Yuna be in charge of?
choices: Presenting in front of the class
questions.explanation: 유나는 'I'll take care of writing the script.'라고 했다.

questions.q: What does 'no more and no less' tell us about the presentation?
choices: It can be longer than five minutes.
It can be shorter than five minutes.
It should last exactly five minutes.
It should last about ten minutes.
questions.answer: It should last exactly five minutes.
questions.explanation: no more and no less는 '더도 덜도 말고', 즉 정확히 5분이어야 한다는 뜻이다.

questions.q: Why does Tom suggest getting together?
questions.explanation: 'we'd better get together and rehearse'에서 발표를 연습하려고 모이자고 한다.

questions.q: Which is true according to the conversation?
choices: The presentation is due next Monday.
The group will meet in the library on Monday.
questions.answer: The group will meet in the library on Monday.
questions.explanation: 월요일 방과 후 도서관에서 만난다. 발표는 수요일, 4명, 포스터는 지민, 대본은 유나이다.

questions.q: What will Tom most likely do after the conversation?
choices: Pass the plan along to Jimin and Daniel
Design the poster for the group
Change the topic of the presentation
questions.answer: Pass the plan along to Jimin and Daniel
questions.explanation: Tom이 마지막에 'I'll pass the plan along to Jimin and Daniel.'이라고 했다.

questions.q: How does the group decide who does each job?
questions.explanation: 컴퓨터를 잘하는 톰은 사진, 그림을 잘 그리는 지민은 포스터, 목소리가 크고 분명한 다니엘은 발표를 맡는다. 각자 잘하는 것에 따라 정했다.

questions.q: Which best describes Yuna's attitude in the conversation?
questions.explanation: 유나는 일을 공평하게(equally) 나누자고 하고, 각자에게 맞는 역할과 만날 시간까지 정리한다.

questions.q: 다음 중 'due'가 대화에서 쓰인 뜻으로 알맞은 것은?
questions.explanation: 'our group presentation is due next Wednesday'는 발표가 다음 주 수요일로 예정되어(마감이어) 있다는 뜻이다.

questions.q: Which word is closest in meaning to 'rehearse'?
questions.explanation: rehearse는 발표·공연 전에 '미리 연습하다'라는 뜻으로 practice와 가깝다.

questions.q: 'be in charge of'와 의미가 가장 가까운 것은?
questions.explanation: be in charge of와 be responsible for는 모두 '~을 맡다, 책임지다'라는 뜻이다.

questions.q: 대화의 내용과 같은 뜻이 되도록 빈칸에 알맞은 것은? "The presentation ____ last exactly five minutes."
questions.explanation: 대화의 has to(~해야 한다)는 must와 같은 뜻이다.

questions.q: 다음 중 어법상 올바른 문장은?
questions.explanation: had better('d better) 뒤에는 동사원형이 온다.

questions.q: Tom asks, 'When would be convenient for everyone?' How does Yuna answer?
questions.explanation: 유나는 'How about Monday after school?'이라고 월요일 방과 후를 제안한다.
